title: Artyx Desktop plugin extension
description: Contents of extensions["ai.artyx.desktop"] in an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest. Agent Plugins assigns no meaning to this object; Artyx Desktop owns it completely and every other client must ignore it without validating it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS object only. Independent of the plugin's own version and of the Agent Plugins version.

requires.description: Advisory runtime executables the desktop preflights before it spawns a stdio server, such as ["npx"] or ["uvx"].

displayName.description: Product name as written by its vendor. Authored, never derived: prettifying the plugin name yields "Unreal-engine", not "Unreal Engine".

tagline.description: One line for the storefront card. The long prose lives in the portable top-level `description`; do not repeat it here.

category.description: Closed on purpose. A curated marketplace gains nothing from free-form categories, and an open string is how the catalog and the manifest drifted apart before.

capabilities.description: What the plugin does to the user's project, shown as badges.

brandColor.description: The vendor's own brand hex, used behind the logo. A third-party brand mark is the one place the Artyx palette does not apply.

prompts.description: Suggested opening messages offered after install.

experimental.description: Marks the integration as unproven. Absent means false.

artyx.description: Minimum Artyx Desktop version. Only the >= form is supported, because the desktop compares one floor and nothing else.

platforms.description: Operating systems the plugin can install on. Absent means all of them.

userVars.title: Values the user supplies at install time
userVars.description: Declares every ${VAR} used in the `mcp` overlay. The desktop prompts for these, stores them encrypted, and substitutes them at connect time. A name declared here but never referenced, or referenced but never declared, is a validation error.

label.description: Field label in the install dialog.

description.description: Helper text under the field. Say where the value comes from, not what the field is called.

default.description: Pre-fills the field. Required when the name ends in _PORT.

secret.description: Renders a password input and keeps the value out of every log and error. Absent means false. Declare it explicitly; the desktop no longer guesses from the variable's name.

companion.title: Setup the user performs outside Artyx

steps.description: Ordered actions in the other application. One action per step.

docsUrl.description: Upstream documentation for the MCP server this plugin connects to.

prerequisites.description: What must already be installed, such as "Blender 4.x or newer".

mcpOverlay.title: Per-server patch applied on top of the portable mcp.json
mcpOverlay.description: Every key MUST name a server that exists in mcp.json; this is a patch, never a new server. It exists because the specification forbids placeholder expansion in `url`, `command`, and header values, and forbids secrets in `headers` and `env`. So mcp.json ships literal, working defaults, and anything the user configures lives here. `env` and `headers` merge key by key; every other field replaces.
